title: Flash8 re-theme Wave B: Timeline.tsx → light Halo + content tokens
description: Converted packages/authoring-ui/src/Timeline.tsx to the Flash 8 light theme using theme/flash8Theme.ts tokens (Wave A), mirroring the Shell.tsx reference conversion. All hardcoded dark hex replaced: panel/layer-column chrome → chrome.panelBg (#ECECEC); ruler header / footers / gutters → chrome.insetFieldStrip (#D4D4D4); all 1px separators → chrome.separator (#999999); text → chrome.textDefault/textDisabled via chromeFont (Tahoma 11px). Flash-drawn frame pixels use content.*: empty frame #FFFFFF, vertical gridline #EBE9ED (cell borders + ruler ticks), keyframe filled #000000 / blank hollow-white circle, motion-tween span #CCCCFF + black centerline arrow, shape-tween span #CCFFCC + black arrow, broken tween dashed black, selected frame/span #335EA8, playhead #CC0000 (ruler triangle+line, faint red wash on the playhead column). Accent colours that previously read on the DARK panel (layer-type icons, sound note, onion markers, label tags, ease-bar controls, both context-menu popups, HScrollBar, PlayBtn, inset readouts) were re-picked to read on the LIGHT timeline (halo.haloBlue selection, darkened blues/greens/reds, halo input fields). Functionality (tween rendering, selection, drag, button-mode, ease editing) untouched. VERIFY: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build = green (tsc clean); pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run = 44 files / 653 tests passed, 0 failures (no task-1207 fixture failures present). Screenshot deferred (requires Vite+Playwright+Ruffle harness; change is pure token substitution verified by build+tests). Scope: Timeline.tsx only + read-only theme import.
